quests.title: Snapshots

dialogue.t: I wonder how the folks in Fontaine managed to put this clever little thing together? It's so fascinating...
Kamera... Ah, yes, I did go to the Feiyun Commerce Guild a few days ago — asked them to come here to take a picture of me.
Did you come here specially to deliver my picture? Why, thank you. Thank you very much.
That Kamera device really is something. Hmm, perhaps I should look to purchase one...
Ah, right, right. I did go to Feiyun Commerce Guild to request that they take a picture of me here.
How is it? Has the picture been printed already? Let me have a look at it...
Oh, this is not bad at all. Thank you for making the trip here.
I wonder how much this Kamera costs. I'm of a mind to buy one myself...
Have you managed to deliver the pictures?
Thank you, thank you. I'm sorry for troubling you, but we're barely keeping our heads above the water here...
Ah, yes. Please take this Kamera as thanks for your help.
It's no problem. I mean, you did help us, didn't you?
This is not an exceedingly expensive object, either. It's just a sample that our partners in Fontaine gave us.
There are some differences between it and the official model... but the basic functions are all there. It'll definitely be enough for your needs.
And if you take a liking to it, you can also help us with some advertising here and there...
Ahem... Regardless, thanks for your help, and please, take this Kamera with you.

quests.description: Xu of the Feiyun Commerce Guild is currently puzzling over a device known as a Kamera…
